test_f_gold: test the f_gold function to check if an array contains contiguous integers with duplicates allowed
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that validates contiguous integer ranges in an array using a visited array
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to use a set instead of a visited list for checking contiguous integers
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that checks if n array elements form a contiguous integer range
run_f_gold: run the f_gold test suite comparing f_filled against the gold reference implementation
